title: 38-OP (Davlatsoy filiali) binosini joriy ta’mirlash ishlarini bajarish uchun zarur bo‘ladigan qurilish materiallari sotib olish

criteria.label: Товарнинг зарур техник тавсифига қўйиладиган талаблар. Техник топшириқда назарда тутилган хажм, техник параметрлар ва талабларига мувофиқлиги. Иштирокчилар хар бир талаб бўйича асословчи ҳужжатларни илова қилади.
Товарнинг яроқлилик ва сақлаш муддатига қўйиладиган талаблар
Кафолатдан кейинги хизмат кўрсатиш бўйича талаблар (муддати, жойи)
Товарни етказиб бериш даврийлигига ва уни миқдорига қўйиладиган талаблар

subject_uz: 38-sonli oilaviy poliklinika (Davlatsoy filiali) binosini joriy ta'mirlash uchun qurilish materiallari (burchak profil, quvurlar, beton qorishmasi, radiator va boshqalar) xaridi

requirements.summary_uz: Mahsulot texnik vazifada keltirilgan talablarga to'liq javob berishi shart.
requirements.summary_en: The goods must fully meet the requirements in the technical assignment.
requirements.quote: Texnik vazifada keltirilgan talablarga to'liq javob berishi shart.

requirements.summary_uz: Mahsulotga rasmiy ishlab chiqaruvchining sertifikati bo'lishi talab qilinadi.
requirements.summary_en: An official manufacturer certificate for the goods is required.
requirements.quote: Maxsulotga rasmiy ishlab chikaruvchining sertifikati mavjudligi.

requirements.summary_uz: Taklifda mahsulotning texnik parametrlari va ishlab chiqaruvchisi ko'rsatilishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bid must state the technical parameters and manufacturer of the goods.
requirements.quote: Maxsulotning texnik parametrlari va ishlab chiqaruvchisi kursati lishi kerak.

requirements.summary_uz: Texnik hujjatlar ro'yxati (broshyuralar, texnik pasportlar) taklifga ilova qilinadi.
requirements.summary_en: A list of technical documents (brochures, technical passports) is attached to the bid.

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchining omborida mahsulot mavjud bo'lishi va rasm bilan tasdiqlanishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The goods must be in the bidder's own warehouse, confirmed with a photo.
requirements.quote: Таварлар таъминотчининг омборида мавжудлиги (расм илова килиши керак)

requirements.summary_uz: Ishtirokchi boshlang'ich summaning kamida 30 foiziga teng mablag'ga ega bo'lishi va yillik aylanmasini ko'rsatishi kerak.
requirements.summary_en: The bidder must have funds of at least 30% of the starting amount and show its annual turnover.
requirements.quote: Tanlovning boshlang'ich summasining kamida 30% mablag'iga ega bo'lishi

requirements.summary_uz: Yuridik shaxslar birlashmalari (konsorsiumlar) tanlovda ishtirok eta olmaydi.
requirements.summary_en: Consortia of legal entities may not take part.
requirements.quote: Yuridik shaxslar birlashmalari (konsorsiumov) tanlovda ishtirok etishga yo'l qo'yilmaydi.

requirements.summary_uz: Ishlarni (yetkazib berishni) bajarish muddati shartnoma imzolangan kundan boshlab 3 kun.
requirements.summary_en: The performance period is 3 days from contract signing.
requirements.quote: Ishlarni bajarish muddati: shartnoma imzolangan kundan bosh lab 3 kun.

requirements.summary_uz: 30 foiz avans to'lanadi, qolgan 70 foiz to'liq hajm yetkazilgandan keyin to'lanadi.
requirements.summary_en: 30% advance is paid; the remaining 70% is paid after delivery of the full volume.
requirements.quote: Oldindan avans (bo'nak) 30% to'lov amalga oshiriladi.(oldindan tulov)

requirements.summary_uz: Tanlov qiymatidan yuqori takliflar qabul qilinmaydi (hujjatda 134 514 795 so'm, lot sahifasida 134 824 795 so'm).
requirements.summary_en: Bids above the ceiling are not accepted (the document says 134,514,795 UZS, the lot header says 134,824,795 UZS).
requirements.quote: Tanlov qiyinati 134 514 795 so‘m. Ushbu qiymatdan ortiq qiymatdagi takliflar qabul qilinmaydi

requirements.summary_en: A guarantee letter must be provided to replace any defective goods within a short time.

reasons_uz: Hujjatda raqobatni jiddiy cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta shart bor; ularga aniqlik kiritilmaguncha qatnashish tavsiya etilmaydi.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (platformadagi mezonlar): Mahsulot ishtirokchining omborida mavjud bo'lishi va rasm bilan tasdiqlanishi talab qilinadi, shuningdek yetkazib berish avansdan keyin 3 kun ichida bajarilishi kerak. Mahsulotni buyurtma bo'yicha olib keladigan vositachi yetkazib beruvchilar bu talabga javob bera olmasligi mumkin, vaholanki buyumlar keng tarqalgan (lot narxi 134 824 795 so'm).

Xarid predmetiga aloqasi bo'lmagan talab (platformadagi mezonlar): Kafolatdan keyingi xizmat ko'rsatish mezoni uchun ball ishtirokchining qonun talablariga zid harakat qilmasligi haqidagi kafolat xati bilan beriladi. Bu xat kafolatdan keyingi xizmatga aloqador emas va mezonning 20 ballik maksimumi shu hujjatga bog'langan.

Xarid predmetiga aloqasi bo'lmagan talab (platformadagi mezonlar): Tovarning texnik tavsifiga mosligi mezoni (20 ball) ishtirokchining umumiy hujjatlari (guvohnoma, ustav, pasport nusxasi) bilan baholanadi. Bu hujjatlar mahsulot xususiyatlari haqida hech narsa bildirmaydi va har bir ishtirokchida bor.

Lot hajmiga nomutanosib moliyaviy talab (6-bet): Ishtirokchi boshlang'ich summaning kamida 30 foiziga (taxminan 40,4 mln so'm) teng mablag'ga ega bo'lishi kerak, shu hujjatning boshqa bandida esa 20 foiz aylanma mablag' ko'rsatilgan. Ikki xil ko'rsatkich kichik yetkazib beruvchilarni chalg'itishi mumkin.

Raqobatni cheklashi mumkin bo'lgan boshqa shart (1-bet): Tanlov hujjatida eng yuqori narx 134 514 795 so'm, lot sahifasida esa boshlang'ich narx 134 824 795 so'm (farqi 310 000 so'm). Bu farq narxi chegaraga yaqin takliflarning rad etilishiga olib kelishi mumkin.
reasons_en: The document holds several conditions that may seriously limit competition; bidding is not advised until they are clarified.

Other clause that may limit competition (platform criteria form): The goods must already be in the bidder's own warehouse and shown by photo, and delivery is due within 3 days after the advance. Suppliers who source the goods to order may be shut out, although the items are widely traded (lot price 134,824,795 UZS).

Requirement unrelated to the subject of the purchase (platform criteria form): The post-warranty service criterion (max 20 points) is scored on a letter promising not to act against legal requirements. That letter has no bearing on post-warranty service, and it appears to be standard template wording.

Requirement unrelated to the subject of the purchase (platform criteria form): The technical-conformity criterion (20 points) is scored on general company papers (registration certificate, charter, passport copy). These say nothing about the goods and every bidder has them; it looks like standard template wording.

Financial demand out of proportion to the lot (page 6): Bidders need funds of at least 30% of the starting amount (about 40.4 million UZS), while another clause of the same document says 20% turnover funds. Two different figures may confuse small suppliers.

Other clause that may limit competition (page 1): The tender document sets the ceiling at 134,514,795 UZS, while the lot page shows 134,824,795 UZS (a 310,000 UZS difference). Bids near the ceiling could be rejected because of this mismatch.
